mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase ampicillin metabolism and reduce antibiotic efficacy; ampicillin may also affect eslicarbazepine levels through enterohepatic circulation alterations.
action: Monitor antibiotic efficacy clinically; consider alternative antibiotics or increased ampicillin dosing if eslicarbazepine co-administration is necessary; verify adequate seizure control.
